target.description: Target names a cluster and account from the server's config.

namespace_mode.description:
NamespaceMode is owned (the app's alone, the default) or shared with
other apps, which then may change only resources they own.

release.description: Release is how changes reach the environment.

approval.description: Approval is who must say yes before a change applies.

ci_required.description: CIRequired refuses to deploy a commit unless CI passed on it.

allow_dirty.description:
AllowDirty lets an operator's CLI deploy uncommitted changes here, for
a dev environment. Never set it for production.

on_merge.description:
OnMerge deploys when CI finishes green on the main branch; for an
environment that needs approval it only opens the request.

promote_from.description: PromoteFrom is the environment whose verified artifact this one takes.

Environment.description: Environment is one place an app may deploy.

name.description: Name is the app's name; it matches the repo's .dray/config.yaml.

repo.description: Repo is the GitHub repository, owner/name.

path.description: Path is the app's folder inside the repo, when it is not the root.

kind.description: Kind is app (the default) or component.

release_on.description: ReleaseOn says when a component builds a version: on a version tag.

environments.description: Environments are where an app may deploy, by name (dev, staging, prod).

third_party.description: ThirdParty lists upstream images this app may run, mirrored by digest.

title: Dray registry entry
description: RegistryEntry is an app's file in the registry: which repo it is, where it may deploy, and who approves.
